page.overview:
Who is Ted Tonks?

Edward "Ted" Tonks (d. March 1998) was a Muggle-born wizard and a member of the Tonks family. He was the husband of Andromeda Tonks (née Black), father of Nymphadora Tonks, and maternal grandfather of Teddy Lupin. He attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where he was sorted into an unknown House.

When Ted married Andromeda, who was born into a prejudiced pure-blood family, her family singled her out for her disobedience towards their rules. The couple had one child, Nymphadora, who became a member of the Order of the Phoenix during the Second Wizarding War. Ted and Andromeda were not members of the Order but assisted them occasionally, allowing the Order to use their home as a safe-house during the Battle of the Seven Potters.

When Lord Voldemort succeeded in taking over the Ministry of Magic in 1997 and the Muggle-Born Registration Commission was established, Ted went on the run. He was eventually caught and murdered by a group of Snatchers in March of 1998.

Ted was born into the Tonks family but, unlike his Muggle relatives, was a wizard. He attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and was in the same year as Andromeda, Narcissa, and Bellatrix Black. He met Andromeda during their first year potions class, where he knocked over a Cure for Boils potion. As Bellatrix and Narcissa laughed, Andromeda helped him clean up. He later managed to ask her out on a date to the Three Broomsticks Inn, after which they started dating.
